description: Horaires des lignes Transilien is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Information importante concernant le changement de format de l’offre de transport Afin de se mettre en conformité avec les exigences réglementaires de la loi LOM, des évolutions importantes sont mises en place depuis juillet 2021: Une alimentation quotidienne de l’offre de transport Transilien; La mise en place de nouveaux référentiels (ILICO, ICAR); Une nouvelle structure ... Coverage: France. The portal files it under Horaires et itinéraires. Its keywords are Horaires, Train, Gare de voyageurs, Ile-de-France, Transilien, GTFS. The portal shows 2026-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
